name: Love Island: The Game
source:
Welcome to Love Island: The Game, the interactive story game that puts YOU in the heart of the hit reality TV show ‘Love Island’!

Crack on with hotties who catch your fancy, and PICK which guy or girl you want to couple up with. How will you stir things up in the Villa? Are you here to make friends, or will you do everything it takes to find love? Can you make it all the way to the infamous Love Island final?

Play through three drama-packed seasons, each with a different cast of hot Islanders, unique collectible outfits, and impactful choices to create your own stories!

[From the [url=https://apps.apple.com/us/app/love-island-the-game/id1522699215]App Store[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到爱情岛：游戏，这是一款互动故事游戏，让你置身于热门真人秀节目“爱情岛”的中心！

与你喜欢的帅哥们尽情玩耍，然后选择你想与之配对的男孩或女孩。你要怎样在别墅里搅动事情呢？你来这里是为了交朋友，还是会尽一切努力寻找爱情？你能一路闯入臭名昭著的爱情岛决赛吗？

畅玩三个充满戏剧性的季节，每个季节都有不同的热门岛民演员阵容、独特的收藏服装和有影响力的选择来创造你自己的故事！

[来自[url=https://apps.apple.com/us/app/love-island-the-game/id1522699215]App Store[/url]]
